update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.70 - Legacy parent finder and remote-viewer Legacy Parents tab
Added ----- - "Best legacy parent for your Uma" in Parent Farming settings ranks every saved legacy parent run, with its real inherited sparks, by fit for the trainee you're currently training. - A new Legacy Parents tab in the Remote Log Viewer lists every saved legacy parent run with quality grade, fans, race record, and real sparks via the new /parent-run-archive API.
Fixed ----- - The parent run archive no longer silently drops harvested spark/factor names when parsing saved runs.
